# openai_project_spend_limit (Data Source)

Retrieve a project hard spend limit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "openai_project_spend_limit" "example" {
  project_id = "proj_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->

### Required

- `project_id` (String) project id

- `response_json` (String) Raw JSON response returned by the OpenAI API.
- `threshold_amount` (Number) threshold amount
